title: Power Apps: form fill assistance suggests updates to fields that already have values
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented controls and user licensing requirements are supported. It distinguishes today's form fill assistance from the planned extension and leaves the extension's default, detailed behaviour and metering unconfirmed.

claims.quote: We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to suggest updates to fields that already contain values—not just empty fields.
